basic_info.description: Designed by visionary architect Stanley Saitowitz, this refined 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom, 1,001 sq. ft. residence seamlessly blends form and function with its minimalist aesthetic and cutting-edge features.    The space is defined by exposed concrete ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows with an automated louver system, and 7.5'' wide-plank Austrian oak flooring. A sleek, open-concept kitchen is outfitted with Siematic cabinetry, seamless white Corian countertops, and premium Bosch and Liebherr appliances. Bathrooms are outfitted with Duravit fixtures and Hans Grohe faucets, while Nest climate control and Webpass internet ensure seamless connectivity. The building itself is a study in contemporary design, featuring a rooftop lounge with panoramic city views, a Virtual Doorman, and keyless entry for a streamlined living experience. With instant access to SF's top dining, retail, and cultural hotspots, this is a rare opportunity to own a residence where architecture meets innovation.  This is the Hayes Valley home you have been searching for.
